When installed in a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], '''focus [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]]''' assisted the Jedi in staying more in tune with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], particularly when the user exerted Force energy.<ref name="TFU2">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>

The [[Subject 1138|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]] discovered a focus crystal while on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="TFU2" /> Other examples were the [[Kasha]] crystals from [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]], which aided Force attunement and [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]].<ref name="Lightsabers Guide">''[[Star Wars: Lightsabers: A Guide to Weapons of the Force]]''</ref>
